name: Seven-Day Calendar and Week Display (Experimental)
author: Local campaign mod
description: One package (merged from Seven-Day Calendar and Week Beside Month). Each campaign turn advances the date seven days, and the campaign date shows the week beside the month, for example Japan, Feb 1890 Week 2 (days 1-7 are Week 1, 8-14 Week 2, 29-31 Week 5). Uses a session-only runtime hook. Construction, funds, research, AI and timers keep their original per-turn behavior: this is NOT a balanced weekly simulation. Use a separate test campaign.
